r respective communities;
AND WHEREAS Council considers it prudent to undertake a comprehensive review of the potential impacts of data centre development within North Grenville before establishing the long-term policy framework for such uses;
NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT Council direct municipal staff to undertake a review of the land use planning implications of data centre development within the Municipality of North Grenville, including, but not limited to:
Water consumption, water availability and impacts on municipal and private water resources;
Wastewater servicing capacity and infrastructure requirements;
Electricity demand, grid capacity and impacts on existing and future community needs;
Environmental impacts, including stormwater management, natural heritage, air quality, noise, heat generation and emissions;
Land use compatibility, site suitability, setbacks, building scale and location;
Potential impacts on municipal infrastructure, services and financial resources;
Community impacts, economic benefits, employment opportunities and long-term sustainability; and
Appropriate planning policies, zoning provisions, development standards and approval requirements.
AND FURTHER THAT Council direct staff to incorporate appropriate policies and provisions relating to data centre development into the Municipality's Official Plan review, as applicable;
AND FURTHER THAT pursuant to Section 38 of the
Planning Act
, R.S.O. 1990, c. P.13, Council direct staff to prepare an Interim Control By-law, for a period of one (1) year, to temporarily prohibit data centre development within the Municipality, or such defined area as may be recommended by staff, while the above-noted review and study are undertaken;
AND FURTHER THAT staff obtain any necessary planning and legal advice to establish the appropriate scope, geographic application and provisions of the proposed Interim Control By-law and report back to Council with the required recommendations and implementing by-law.
